explication: 91写作 is a browser-based AI novel-creation workspace. The main workflow is to configure an AI provider, manage a novel and its chapters, then write and generate or polish content; local storage holds user data and billing records. The graph also preserves the documented short-form writing, prompts, tools, book analysis, worldbuilding, goals, and backup/settings capabilities. Some feature-to-service links rely on the README or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
